sloka: एवमश्रान्तवद्वीर शीघ्रमेव महार्णवान् ।मां चैवोद्वहमानस्तु को ऽन्यो वीरः क्रमिष्यति ।। ७.३४.३८ ॥
transliteration: evamaśrāntavadvīra śīghrameva mahārṇavān ।māṁ caivodvahamānastu ko 'nyo vīraḥ kramiṣyati ।। 7.34.38 ॥

translations.english: O hero, who else but you, carrying me and the great oceans, will swiftly and tirelessly traverse them?
